items.name: Readability
items.evidence: The diff is the same as the reference fix. It adds a short, clear comment ('parse_url doesn't provide the netloc with auth') and keeps the existing formatting.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: A 4-line change inside the existing function that reuses the `auth` field from parse_url. No new helpers, no dead code and no debug output left behind.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: The `if auth:` guard means URLs without credentials are untouched. There are no magic constants and no error handling that hides failures. All hidden tests pass (F2P 2/2, P2P 185/185).

items.name: prepend_scheme_if_needed public behaviour unchanged otherwise
items.name_zh: prepend_scheme_if_needed 其他公开行为不变
items.evidence: The signature is unchanged. The only change re-attaches auth with `netloc = '@'.join([auth, netloc])`, so URLs without credentials behave as before. It has no Python-version check and does not patch urllib3.
